title: Where is one body handle's command lost on its way to the predicted consequence?
question: Each of the 26 body handles gets its own part of the command. When one handle's part changes, at which stage between the command and the predicted next proprioception does that change stop being carried as that handle's own change?
about: The first investigation drawn as a live process-of-elimination diagram (the style guide, the operator's rule of Oct 5, 2026). This file declares the stages, the registry rows and files whose readings answer each stage, and the branch taken for each verdict. Every verdict, time, commit and evidence value on the diagram is computed on each read from those rows' runner records and results (Source/Python/mimo_bridge/tools/elimination.py). Revised Oct 5, 2026 on the dashboard review's finding F11: the question is where each handle's change loses its own direction, so the motor-token stages are read by a direction reading against the real changes' own, the size readings are related readings, and the reading taken at the predicted next proprioception names the three components it is taken after. Revised Oct 7, 2026 12:02 AM PDT by the coordinator: the attention cap experiment's handle-direction check (row attention_cap_qual_handle_direction) added as related readings of the transformer stage and the prediction stage, shown and never deciding.
written_by: the dashboard fix agent, branch dashboard/recovery-2026-10-05 (the first version: the dashboard agent, 10:27 AM PDT)

input.name: 26 handle commands

stages.name: pooling attention
stages.question: With both paths beside the pool switched off, does each handle's change of the motor token keep a direction of its own: are the 26 handles' token changes, made through the 2 attention layers among the handles and the 4 pooling heads (each a softmax-weighted sum over the 26 handles), no nearer to one shared line than the 26 handles' real changes of proprioception are?

sources.means: at or below the real changes' own sharing = the token keeps the handles at least as far apart as the body's own consequences are; the file was computed from the samples of row investigate_motor_handle_reach_481800 after its run ended, so it is no registry result

stages.name: transformer blocks
stages.question: Through the transformer's blocks (attention and routing), does each handle's change keep a direction of its own, as it does in the motor token, and if not, at which block do the 26 handles' changes fall onto one shared direction?

sources.means: at or below the real changes' own sharing = the handles' changes keep their own directions through block 0's cross-modal attention; above it = they fall onto one shared direction there, where one attention head alone carries the motor slot's change to the proprioception slot
